info.title: MiBi-Portal Server
info.description:
This is the api of the MiBi-Portal server.

**CSRF protection.** Every request other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS needs a CSRF token, except `POST /orders/results`. Any GET answers with an `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie; send that cookie back together with its value in the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header. A missing or wrong token is answered with 403.

**Whitespace.** The server removes leading and trailing whitespace and line breaks from every string of a request body and of a successful response. Exceptions: `password` and `oldValue` are kept as sent, and the result values of `POST /orders/results` and `POST /orders/samples-with-results` are passed on untouched.

put.summary: Convert a sample set to an Einsendebogen excel file or enrich a parsed sample sheet
put.description:
The request body is JSON in one of two forms:
- `parsedSampleSheet`: an Einsendebogen that was already read into JSON. The server assigns each sample its NRL and default analysis and answers with the order.
- `order`: an order, to be converted into an Einsendebogen excel file.

Raw excel uploads (`multipart/form-data`) are no longer accepted and are answered with 400.

The `Accept` header selects the answer: `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet` returns the Einsendebogen as a base64 encoded file, anything else returns the order as JSON.

ErrorCode.description:
- 1: Unknown error
- 2: Authorization error
- 3: Authentication error
- 4: Input error
- 5: Invalid input
- 6: Autocorrected input
- 7: Invalid version
- 8: Invalid email
- 9: Order could not be saved
- 10: Order could not be submitted
- 11: Order not found
- 12: Access to the order is forbidden
- 13: Invalid analysis data

clientVersion.description: Version number of the client bundle deployed with this server; empty if no bundle is deployed

keycloakEnabled.description: Whether the login runs through Keycloak instead of the legacy login form

zipCity.description: Zip code and city, e.g. "10589 Berlin"

ParsedSampleSheetAnalysis.description: Analysis options as read from the sheet: 1 = selected, 0 = not selected

nrl.description: NRL as written in the sheet; checked by the server

selector.description: Patterns of the pathogens this NRL is responsible for

results.description: Result counter as shown in the order list, e.g. "2 / 5"

ResultDataValue.description: A result value as delivered by the laboratory: text, a number, a boolean or null

ResultData.description: Result values keyed by result field, e.g. {"Biotyp": 4}

StoreResultsRequestData.description: One element per result, keyed by the Parse objectId of its sample. A sample can have more than one result.

results.description: New result counter of the order

created.description: Every result row that was created

endSessionUrl.description: Keycloak URL that ends the single sign-on session

InvalidInputErrorResponse.description: The supplied sample contains validation errors or autocorrections

Standard422ErrorResponse.description: The request was understood but refused

PutSamplesRequest.description: A set of samples and meta data

PostSubmittedRequest.description: Request for sending sample data to the BfR
